notes: Only requested unfinished fields are assessed; all unassigned fields and original side are placeholders. No PDF was supplied; layout could be checked only in canonical text. Participant age was standardized at the participant-level and both Gender Inequality Index (GII) and Gender Development Index (GDI) were standardized at the country-level prior to analyses. These measures were chosen because of their similarity to the Gender Empowerment Measure and Gender-related Development Index used in Eagly and Wood (1999). Printed estimate retained without conversion; requested b (unstd) is not a printed metric label. The predictor standardization is explicitly documented. Table 1 identifies the controlled interaction, rather than the alternative model omitting world region.
